description:
darwin.nix (104 lines) is functional but has several gaps compared to host.nix (154 lines):

1. Missing secrets directory creation — agents with secretName will fail
2. config.json missing extraAttrs (uid, gid, authorizedKeys) — Go CLI may expect these
3. chown missing group specification (line 81: chown user vs chown user:group)
4. No explicit file mode on environment.etc config entries
5. No user existence assertion (both modules should have this)
6. No documentation of platform-specific config.json field differences

Also: verify Go CLI (config/config.go) handles missing fields gracefully on darwin.
title: darwin.nix: complete module for feature parity with host.nix
